questions.question: Is CgCommand3P admin-only — does it dispatch group creation on pageA only, with check(m) true only when m.groupId === null && !m.memberA? Cite the run target and check body.
Does InCommand3P(invitee) take invitee: "B"|"C" only (inviter always A), with check(m) true only when m.memberA && !m.actorIsMember(invitee)? Cite the constructor type and check.
Is the already-a-member invite shape pruned by check() (so fast-check never generates it) rather than silently no-op'd at run time? Cite the check predicate that excludes it.
Does LgCommand3P(actor) accept actor: "A"|"B"|"C" and have each actor leave through their own pageX? Cite the run target selection.

Does FdCommand3P let actor A forget any leaf belonging to B or C in the shared group, with check(m) true only when m.memberA && (m.memberB || m.memberC) && m.groupId !== null (forget-by-non-admin rejected at model level)? Cite the check.
Is RdCommand3P(actor,name) per-actor for the actor's own device (renames on the actor's own page)? Cite the run.

Does SwCommand3P switch pageA between bunker A and bunker B ONLY (never generating A↔C or B↔C), and is the reason documented inline in a comment naming AC-3P-SW-1? Cite the switch logic and the comment.

Are the MIP-03 admin-only-commit constraints encoded as model preconditions in check() (InCommand3P inviter==A, Fd by A only) rather than runtime guards/fc.pre discards, keeping random-action density high (Design Decision #2)?

Do the lifecycle commands correctly update ModelState3P membership/group bookkeeping (Cg sets memberA+groupId; In sets invitee membership; Lg clears the leaver's membership) consistent with the assertions in S4?

Does the Lg command preserve the 2-party guard that prevents a sole-member leave (a member only leaves when another member remains) so the harness does not generate degenerate empty-group counterexamples?
Is the SwCommand3P identity-switch bookkeeping (capture priorGroupIds into m.lastSwitched before switching, reset memberA/groupId/epochSequenceA after) consistent with what assertS7_3P expects in S4?
